title: Busk
summary: A town near Chmielnik where Rabbi Isaiah'le served as rabbi.

claims.uncertaintyNote: The text says he traveled there with representatives; this was not necessarily migration.

qualifiers.purpose: sent three wagons to bring bread

events.title: Deportation of Jews from Busk
events.summary: Jews from Busk were gathered, taken by carts toward Pińczów, and transferred from there to Treblinka.
